pins.name: ST
pins.function: Open-drain source status: high/Hi-Z IN1; low IN2

notes: Page 4 Figure 6-2 is a BOTTOM view. The large power pads are numbered 1, 2, 7 and 8. There is no additional exposed ground pad or pin 13.
Pages 5–8: operating inputs are 2.8–22 V, absolute maximum 24 V. Control pins operate at 0–5.5 V, absolute maximum 6 V. RILM is 18–100 kΩ. The ST pull-up is 6–20 kΩ.

Pages 13–21: both channels block reverse current, with finite detection current and response time. Measure hot-plug and backfeed behavior. VREF rising threshold is 1.01–1.10 V and control leakage is ±0.1 µA.

pins.name: EP
pins.function: Exposed thermal pad, must share VSS potential

notes: Use the lower BQ24074 diagram on page 7, not the BQ24075 SYSOFF variant. The thermal pad uses project symbol/footprint number 17; the source names it Thermal Pad. Connect VSS pin 8 as well. The saved PDF package appendix on page 52 is RGT0016C.
Pages 10–14: recommended input is 4.35–10.2 V, system output 4.3–4.5 V and battery regulation 4.16–4.23 V. BAT and OUT each require 4.7–47 µF bypass. IN requires 1–10 µF.
EN2/EN1 modes: 00 gives 100 mA maximum, 01 gives 500 mA maximum, 10 selects ILIM, and 11 suspends input. CE high disables charging while preserving the power path and battery supplement.

Page 13: TS bias is 72–78 µA, cold threshold 2.0–2.2 V and hot threshold 270–330 mV. Page 30 says the passive Rs/Rp network can widen but cannot narrow the temperature window. Direct B3435 sensing does not guarantee the present pack’s 0–45°C charging window.
Pages 28–30: CHG can remain low during a temperature fault, so it is not a safe-to-charge signal. Timers slow proportionally during DPPM, input-DPM and thermal charge reduction.

pins.name: MODE
pins.function: Low = power-save mode; high = forced PWM

notes: Pages 4 and 35 show all ten physical pads. The larger functional pads are 6–10. There is no additional exposed pad or ground pin 11.
Pages 5–6: VIN operates at 1.3–5.5 V, with startup above 1.8 V and 6 V absolute maximum. Output range is 1.8–5.2 V. Converter UVLO is not a safe lithium-ion discharge endpoint.
Pages 6 and 18: feedback voltage is 0.500 V ±1% in PWM; bias-current magnitude is at most 100 nA. The lower feedback resistor must be at most 100 kΩ. MODE and EN must not float.

Pages 18–20: nominal inductance is 0.47 µH with effective range 0.37–0.57 µH. Above 3.6 V output use two nominal 22 µF capacitors. Minimum effective output capacitance is 7 µF; the project target is at least 8.2 µF. Minimum effective input capacitance is 4 µF; the project target is at least 5 µF. Boost peak current limit can reach 5.75 A; verify inductor saturation.
Pages 3–5: VIN operates at 1–5.5 V. ON accepts 3.3 V logic and must not float. The 2 A maximum switch current is not a current limiter. There is no exposed pad.
Pages 14–17: QOD can connect directly to VOUT, through a resistor, or remain floating to disable discharge. QOD is not GND.
Isolate panel signal paths separately when the output is off. A series resistor alone does not provide that isolation.
Page 4 DQA top view was inspected. There is no exposed pad. NC pins 6, 7, 9 and 10 can float or connect to ground; the project leaves them floating.

Pages 6–7: four independent channels discharge to ground, without a VCC clamp rail. Use them for USB D+, D−, CC1 and CC2, not VBUS. Operating signal maximum is 5.5 V, capacitance 0.5 pF typical and DC breakdown at least 6.5 V. This does not protect sustained CC-to-VBUS shorts.

pins.name: EP
pins.function: Exposed thermal pad, internally connected to GND

notes: Page 3 Figure 4-3 is the selected DRV pinout, which differs from DBV. Original pixels were inspected. Package pages 38–40 explicitly number the exposed pad 7.

Pages 4–6: input range is 1.45–5.5 V and output is nominally 3.3 V. DRV dropout at 1 A is at most 425 mV through 85°C and 475 mV through 125°C. Output accuracy is ±1% through 85°C and ±1.5% over the full temperature range; observe the table’s test conditions.
Pages 18–21: effective input and output capacitors must exceed 0.47 µF; use 10 µF nominal each. The device does not block reverse current. Do not externally drive +3V3 while its input is off.

DRV JEDEC thermal resistance is 100.2°C/W. Solder the thermal pad to the ground plane. At a 0.65 V drop and 0.6 A, 0.39 W would produce about a 39°C rise on that reference board. Validate the actual enclosure and copper layout.
Page 3 shows the selected 14-pin PW package, with no exposed pad. Active-high SEL inputs have internal 6 MΩ pulldowns.
Pages 4, 6 and 7: VDD operates at 1.5–5.5 V. Source/drain voltage may reach 3.6 V with VDD below 1.5 V. Powered-off leakage is ±2 µA over the full temperature range; the 10 nA figure applies at 25°C.
On resistance is at most 4.5 Ω and on leakage is ±50 nA. Operating supply current is 37 µA typical, 70 µA maximum. SEL1 tied to +3V3 connects the ADC automatically without a GPIO.

Maximum power-off transition time is 4 µs under the specified 1 µs supply-fall test. This is not an unconditional MCU injection-current guarantee for arbitrary ramps. Measure brownout and decay waveforms. The static off-state ADC bound is 0.2 V with its 100 kΩ pulldown.
Page 5 marks physical polarity rather than numbered leads. Project convention is pin 1 = cathode, pin 2 = anode. Verify the footprint stripe against the drawing.

Page 2: standoff is 6.0 V, breakdown 6.67–7.37 V at 10 mA, and maximum clamp 10.3 V at 19.4 A for a 10/1000 µs pulse at 25°C. Nonrepetitive pulse rating is 200 W. Reverse leakage is at most 400 µA at 6 V. Apply temperature derating.

This is an input hot-plug/ESD TVS. Its rated clamp is below the mux’s 24 V and charger’s 28 V absolute maxima. It is not a 5.5 V rail clamp or sustained-overvoltage protection. Source current limiting and surge/thermal qualification are required.

Capacity is 1100 mAh minimum, 1130 mAh typical. Operating range is 2.75–4.20 V; charging voltage 4.2 V ±50 mV. Maximum charge current is 550 mA and continuous discharge 1100 mA. Charging is allowed at 0–45°C; discharge at −20 to 60°C.
The PCM overcurrent trip of 2–4.5 A does not protect a 1 A connector. The listed overdischarge resume voltage of 2.50 V is below its 2.75 V detection voltage and needs vendor clarification.
The NTC is 10 kΩ ±1% at 25°C with B3435, but B tolerance and full resistance/temperature table are unspecified. Battery connector mapping, charging and battery mechanical release remain blocked.
